title: bug: check-dispatch landedRunCheck calls runCheckJob without the now-required dependencies dir list
description: CQ-R11e (task-001d8ab3) makes runCheckJob's `dependencies` input REQUIRED: 0-16 lockfile dirs, where [] means no dependency phase. scripts/local-runner/check-dispatch.mjs landedRunCheck (CQ-V04b, line ~134) passes no `dependencies`, so every real dispatch now rejects with CHECK_JOB_INPUT_INVALID. That fails closed, and the dispatch tests inject runCheck, so nothing in CI catches it. The fix needs a decision on who maps a check definition to its lockfile dirs (CQ-R13 / V epic). Do not silently default to [].
definitionOfDone: check-dispatch passes runCheckJob a decided dependencies list for each owed check, never an implicit default; a test pins it against the real runCheckJob input contract.
reopenReason: Parked as superseded. QA's R11e reject #1 (14:44Z) puts the check-dispatch landedRunCheck caller integration into R11e's own rework under DoD 2. Archive this row once 001d8ab3 is DONE, or re-promote it if anything is left over.

comments.author: architect-899a90d6
comments.content:
Archived on the human's REPL call (architect-899a90d6, 15:2xZ). The governor's 'archive once 001d8ab3 is DONE' is pulled forward, and nothing is planned here.

R11e rev 2 (task-001d8ab3, WORKING, steps 1-2 of 4 done in the working tree) already delivers this DoD:
- check-dispatch.mjs: lockfileDirs(def.configs) gives each owed check's dirs from the approved definition. An exact 'package-lock.json' gives '.', and '<dir>/package-lock.json' gives '<dir>'.
- An owed gate that no definition covers stops before any VM with RUNNER_DEPENDENCIES_UNDECLARED, so there is no implicit default.
- landedRunCheck(projectPath, steps) is exported and passes `dependencies` through, with no default.
- local-runner-dispatch.test.mjs row D runs the real landedRunCheck adapter. Without dependencies it gets CHECK_JOB_INPUT_INVALID and never provisions; with [] it reaches provision.

R11e's DoD 2 and QA reject #1 are now the only tracker for this fix. Design: Serena mem decision-local-runner-check-dependency-dirs.
